answer: Copying the same citations across 142 aliases therefore burns the authoring cost 142 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the signal index resolves every citation against the willow checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the oasis audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. That is 21 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
